label: Gold
tooltip: Gold in the crown's chest. Taxes fill it each month; salaries and your orders empty it.

label: Civil goods
tooltip: Civil goods, in gold: food, timber, cloth and wares. The harvest and your provinces fill them each month; the court eats from them and building spends them.

label: Strategic goods
tooltip: Strategic goods, in gold: iron, horses, arms and ships. Your provinces fill them each month; the levy and the campaign spend them — the army goes as far as they stretch.

label: People
tooltip: Everyone in the realm's towns and countryside. Levies are drawn from them.

label: Host
tooltip: The realm's soldiers under arms, by regiment.

label: Army
tooltip: How well drilled the levies are. Drills lapse without fresh levies.

label: Unrest
tooltip: How close the villages are to rioting. Tax pressure and famine raise it.

label: Legitimacy
tooltip: How firmly the court believes the crown is yours by right.

label: Contentment
tooltip: The mood of the common folk.

label: Church
tooltip: How the pulpits regard the crown.

label: Infantry
tooltip: Foot soldiers: the bulk of any host.

label: Archers
tooltip: Bowmen who thin a charge before it lands.

label: Cavalry
tooltip: Mounted troops: costly, and decisive on open ground.

label: Artillery
tooltip: Siege engines and guns; slow, but walls fear them.

label: Fleet
tooltip: Warships crewed from the coast towns.

label: Walls
tooltip: A walled town: harder to take, and its market is taxed at the gate.

label: Citadel
tooltip: A citadel commands the town; a garrison can hold it.

label: Temple
tooltip: A temple: the church has a house here.

label: Market
tooltip: A market square: goods change hands and the town grows.

label: Shanty town
tooltip: A shanty town outside the walls: the poor crowd in.

label: Port
tooltip: A harbour: ships and sea trade come and go.

label: Food
tooltip: Food goods.

label: Ore
tooltip: Ores and metals.

label: Mineral
tooltip: Quarried and mined minerals.

label: Building
tooltip: Building materials.

label: Luxury
tooltip: Luxuries the wealthy pay for.

label: Arms
tooltip: Goods of war.

label: Naval
tooltip: Goods for ships.

label: Cloth
tooltip: Cloth and clothing.

label: Fuel
tooltip: Fuel.

label: Coin
tooltip: Coin.

label: Supply
tooltip: Beasts and supplies.

label: Preserving
tooltip: Salt and what keeps food from spoiling.

label: Ritual
tooltip: Goods for the church and its rites.

label: Storage
tooltip: Barrels and what goods are kept in.

label: Fishing
tooltip: What the waters give.

label: Learning
tooltip: Books and the tools of learning.

label: Wealth
tooltip: What the town produces in a season.

label: Treasury
tooltip: Coin in the town's own chest.

label: Towns
tooltip: The realm's townsfolk: everyone living inside a burg's walls or streets.

label: Country
tooltip: The realm's country folk: everyone on the land, in villages and on farms.

label: Manor house
tooltip: A stone hall for the steward: rents in full, a yard that can be held, a lord in residence.

label: Mill
tooltip: A mill: the manor grinds its own grain and sends flour to the royal granaries.

label: Granary
tooltip: A stone granary: the harvest keeps.

label: Chapel
tooltip: A chapel with its own priest: the pulpit speaks well of the crown.

label: Palisade
tooltip: A ditch and timber wall: a raid has to work for it, and the villages sleep easier.

label: Market
tooltip: A weekly market by charter: tolls, stall rents, and cloth changing hands.
